basic_profile.bio: I'm an enthusiastic Scooby-Doo fan from Portland, Oregon, who recently discovered the vibrant Reddit community. I work as a graphic designer, which allows me to enjoy flexible hours, usually online in the evenings after work. I'm single and love spending my free time diving into cartoons, particularly those from my childhood. Besides Scooby-Doo, I also have a soft spot for fashion games and enjoy exploring new styles in my downtime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of Scooby-Doo stems from years of watching and rewatching the shows and movies. I've also engaged with fan communities and have read a lot about the lore, though I'm still learning about the finer details. My interest in fashion games is fairly recent, sparked by playing mobile games during my breaks.
